column2: 126. All members of the OIT Board, OIT Director General
and  the  officers  and  other  employees  of  the  OIT  shall  be
deemed to be public servants within  the meaning, and for
the purposes of the Penal Code (Chapter 19).
127. The OIT shall be deemed to be a scheduled institution
within  the  meaning,  and  for  the  purposes  of  the  Anti-
Corruption Act, No. 9 of 2023 and the provisions of that Act
128. (1) Any expense incurred by the OIT in any suit or
prosecution brought by or against the OIT before any Court,
shall be paid out of the Fund of the OIT and any costs paid
to, or recovered by the OIT in any such suit or prosecution
shall be credited to the Fund of the OIT.
